item.title: Trump officials cut political interference ban after unusual Census Bureau report
item.description: After the Census Bureau issued a report tied to a Trump-aligned think tank, the bureau's parent agency cut language banning political interference from its scientific integrity policy, NPR learned.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Kalshi bans former congressman George Santos for life after State of the Union trades
item.description: Kalshi says Santos did not cooperate with its investigation into bets he placed on his own attendance at the State of the Union. The company also fined the disgraced congressman more than $71,000.

item.title: Trump says U.S. struck deal to take control of 65 billion barrels Venezuelan oil
item.description: President Trump is touting a new deal for the U.S. to access Venezuelan oil fields. Trump says it's a major boon for the American people, but it's unclear when they'll see the benefits.

item.title: The U.S.-Venezuela oil deal won't lower your gas prices. Here's what you need to know
item.description: The Trump administration announced a deal Friday to develop a vast amount of Venezuela's oil reserves, with the U.S. taking a majority stake. Energy experts say there are many reasons to be skeptical.

item.title: Funding bill at the top of the agenda as House returns from recess
item.description: The House returns Monday for one week before heading back home. At the top of the agenda is a bill to extend government funding past the midterm elections.

item.title: Canada claps back at Trump's efforts to rename Lake Ontario as 'Lake America'
item.description: Ontario Premier Doug Ford has unveiled a giant billboard reading: "Lake Ontario — Now and Always." But tech giant Google has said it is renaming the lake for U.S. users, as President Trump demanded.

item.title: Are you sure that Kimmel clip was real? Late-night AI deepfakes are spreading online
item.description: While social media is rife with AI celebrity deepfakes, videos featuring late night TV hosts like Jimmy Kimmel and Jon Stewart are are easier to create than other kinds of deepfakes and potentially more disruptive.
